description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system, specifying a method for outputting log data with different priority levels, tags, messages, and optional throwable exceptions.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for a logging node that outputs log entries to a target such as console or file, allowing implementation of various logging behaviors and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log entry with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable object.
